body:
Add native Chinese nine-key Pinyin as one usable input path, using the existing
`luna_pinyin` dictionary and user dictionary. Enable `luna_pinyin_t9` through the
existing scheme selector and deploy it; both stock themes provide the layout.

Related #1464, #1299, and the spelling-filtering part of #459. This does not close
the broader editing or prediction requests.

The feature provides:

- Digit input, syllable choice/locking, segment focus, unlocking, undo and cancel.
  Native revisions reject stale spelling actions.
- Displayed spelling and caret mapping through native edits, preedit touches and
  editor restarts. Private lock markers stay out of displayed/raw-code commits.
  Hanzi candidates keep their existing batched API; spelling state uses one
  additional snapshot, rather than a JNI call per candidate.
- Matching layouts, literal number/symbol pages, long-press digits, tests and
  [switching behavior](https://github.com/X2M7/trime/blob/9f86bc8f1d11d65d2e22e437f111a965bc2faba5/doc/t9-input.md).

Prediction, privacy policy, candidate pinning, broad accessibility/viewport
changes and fork release configuration are outside this feature.

Dependencies and current source:

- Current head is `9f86bc8f`. It normally merges the independent deferred input-view
  startup fix #2188 at `2d2fbce7`. That one-file dependency is included in
  the current diff and validated together, rather than folded into a T9 commit.
- #2187 supplies the TextView state correction, and #2186 covers the shared
  standard-UTF-8/UTF-16 JNI transport. Both fixes remain separately reviewable.
  Upstream JNI ownership/source-directory changes and Snappy 1.3.1 are integrated
  through `12ffd16f`.
- The previous `eeb4804a` theme correction preserves Chinese mode on the standard
  theme's inherited symbol-category page; literal digit/English pages remain ASCII.

Validation:

- Current-head [fork APK builds](https://github.com/X2M7/trime/actions/runs/39723620640),
  upstream checks and [application/JNI control](https://github.com/X2M7/trime/actions/runs/39723643304)
  are in progress. Fixed-head Android checks are pending.
- At parent `eeb4804a`, 330 application JVM cases and 115 separate real-JVM Unicode
  assertions passed; fork and upstream each passed four OS builds. The original
  fork APK, signatures, four ABIs, assets and 20 recursive pins were checked.
  All fork native caches hit, so this is not a new native compile/link claim.
- That parent's Android 15 run qualified standard-theme C1–C8 plus the category
  macro and default-theme C1–C6. Its separate tail run failed before C7/C8:
  theme readiness left an empty IME view. The [actual failure and diagnostic
  control](https://github.com/X2M7/trime/blob/3f1cac2b9793891459755d939ca4c14fc2cb7225/doc/contribution-split/checks/deferred-input-view-negative-20261022/provenance.json)
  are preserved. Neither the unexecuted tail nor any previous-source result is
  presented as a current-head pass.
- Prior unchanged-native inputs have 743 pinned-engine assertions, eight strict
  NDK translation-unit checks and 146 separate real-JVM assertions. Those were
  not rerun for the theme/startup changes.

The PR remains Draft. Existing native/theme/dependency/tool and Debug signature
warnings remain visible. This does not claim full application, Release, physical
device, TalkBack, general candidate-race or performance acceptance. Historical
failures and exact-source evidence remain in the
[fork-only contribution index](https://github.com/X2M7/trime/tree/contrib/split-index/doc/contribution-split).
title: feat: add nine-key Pinyin input with syllable selection
